mcp_server.description: Expose local VRCX-0 social facts to trusted MCP clients. By default, it only listens on localhost.
mcp_server.enable_description: Starts an HTTP MCP server protected by a bearer token. Localhost-only access is the default.
mcp_server.allow_vrchat_writes_description: When off, favorite-to-VRChat tool calls are forced to dry-run. Turn on to let AI write favorites to your real VRChat account. Resets to off each time the server starts.
mcp_server.allow_lan_connections_description: Listen on all IPv4 interfaces so other devices on your local network can connect with this computer's IP address and the bearer token. Keep off on untrusted networks.
mcp_server.port_description: Changing it restarts the server. If 8798 is taken, pick a free port and re-copy the client config.
mcp_server.client_config_description: Pick the option for your client. Claude Code: a one-time `claude mcp add` terminal command. Generic (HTTP): a JSON config for a direct HTTP connection — no extra tools. Generic (mcp-remote): a JSON config that tunnels via a Node.js proxy for clients without native HTTP (e.g. Claude Desktop); needs Node.js in PATH. When LAN connections are enabled, copied configs use `YOUR-LAN-IP`; replace it with this computer's local IP before using them from another device.
mcp_server.security_note: Client configs contain a plain-text token. Only share them with tools or devices you trust.
mcp_server.rotate_token_description: Old client configs stop working after rotation.
